description: On the bed in front of you are a bright yellow spoon, a white dustpan-shaped tray, a small pink rubber duck, and a few small items off to the right. The left hand reaches forward and grasps the yellow spoon as a left-hand object, lifts it up and slightly rightward, then moves it over the white tray and lowers it in, releasing the spoon so it rests inside; the right hand stays nearby, hovering without touching anything.
